zh.title: FAA 暫緩 737 MAX 10 認證　Boeing 處理特定進場情境軟體問題
zh.summary: FAA 局長表示，認證將等到軟體問題完成修正；美國運輸部其後稱目前未見既有機隊安全疑慮。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）局長 Bryan Bedford 於 2026 年 9 月 28 日表示，Boeing 737 MAX 10 的型別認證程序將暫緩，直到一項自動導航功能的軟體問題完成解決。該問題涉及特定進場與降落情境。
Boeing 曾在 7 月宣布 737-10 完成最後一項預定認證試飛，但完成試飛不等同取得型別認證。FAA 尚未提供新的核准時間表，軟體修正與後續驗證仍須完成。
美國運輸部長 Sean Duffy 於 9 月 30 日表示，目前未把該問題視為既有 737 MAX 機隊的安全疑慮。這項說法不代表 MAX 10 已獲核准，認證時程仍取決於 FAA 對修正結果的審查。

en.title: FAA pauses 737 MAX 10 certification over software issue
en.summary: The regulator will wait for Boeing to resolve an automated-navigation problem tied to a specific approach and landing scenario.
body: Federal Aviation Administration chief Bryan Bedford said on September 28, 2026 that certification of the Boeing 737 MAX 10 would remain on hold until a software issue affecting an automated-navigation function was resolved. The issue concerns a specific approach and landing scenario.

Boeing said in July that the 737-10 had completed its final planned certification flight, but completion of flight testing is not type certification. The FAA has not given a revised approval date and the software change still requires verification.

U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said on September 30 that officials did not currently view the issue as a safety concern for the in-service 737 MAX fleet. That statement does not constitute MAX 10 approval; the schedule still depends on the FAA's review of Boeing's fix.

facts.claim: FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said MAX 10 certification would wait for resolution of an automated-navigation software issue.
The issue is tied to a specific approach and landing scenario; no revised certification date was provided.
The U.S. transportation secretary said officials did not currently see a safety concern for the in-service 737 MAX fleet.
Boeing announced in July 2026 that the 737-10 had completed its final planned certification flight.
